 3. Output format is a table with columns "Key Product Name" and "Distribution Outlet Count", sorted in descending order by distribution outlet count
 4. Values should be integers (outlet counts are natural numbers)

 7. Output the Top 10 key products and their distribution outlet counts; if fewer than 10 exist, output all of them
